items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability Leading to Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to switch a customer session to another customer account, granting access to the victim's account and private data. Exploitation requires no existing account, administrator privileges, or user interaction.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.summary: This high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could lead to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Adobe Commerce B2B)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability Leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: This low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload via REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API, named PolyShell, allowing unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique to bypass validation. Adobe released a fix in Magento 2.4.9.
